subject: [PATCH 11/60] fork: check cached stack locality only on common memory nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new condition to skip the locality check when the local node has no common memory, allowing CPUs outside these nodes to cache stacks from other nodes.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the fork code to check cached stack locality only on common memory nodes, allowing CPUs outside these nodes to cache stacks from other nodes.
